Subject: FW: Renewal proposal: Premium SLA + capacity reservation — Bluehaven asks

Team — forwarding Bluehaven's reply. They're asking for: tighter 95th SLOs (200/100), regional failover US<->EU, and prefer a 12-month term. Procurement deadline Wed.

Quick assessment: meeting 200/100 consistently at 95th with a cold KV cache is challenging at our current config unless we: increase reserved GPUs, prioritize their traffic on lower-latency instance types, or accept a phased ramp with measured SLOs post-pilot. Pricing delta between 12 and 24 months is significant.

Proposed concession (to present to customer as a structured offer):
- Offer 12-month contract with a 3-month pilot phase: months 1–2 reserve 4 GPUs; month 3 ramp to 8 GPUs. During pilot we guarantee progressive SLOs (95th gen 225ms / embeddings 125ms) with a target to reach 200/100 after month 3 contingent on observed traffic profile and KV warmup.
- Provide 10 burst credits for immediate peaks.
- Provide SOC2 report and a short answers bundle (I'll attach).
- Commercial: offer a 25% retroactive discount on months 4–12 if they convert to a 24-month term within 6 months of go-live.

Attached: cost-model-Bluehaven.xlsx (high level impact on margins).

Look for: legal to confirm amendment language/DocuSign, infra to confirm feasibility of regional failover SLA (David), and sales leadership to sign off on the discount/burst credits (Markus/Marissa).

Thanks —
Vanessa

Subject: RE: Renewal proposal: Premium SLA + capacity reservation — Bluehaven Analytics

Samir — thanks for the clear asks and for the quick turnaround. Per internal approvals, here's the formal path we can offer: 

Offer summary (12-month contract + phased pilot):
- Term: 12 months (option to convert to 24 months with retroactive 25% discount on months 4–12 if conversion occurs within 6 months)
- Capacity ramp: months 1–2 reserved 4 GPUs; month 3 reserved 8 GPUs (steady state thereafter)
- SLOs: pilot-stage guarantees — 95th gen 225ms / embeddings 125ms during months 1–3; target production SLOs 95th gen 200ms / embeddings 100ms after month 3 pending observed traffic and KV warmup metrics
- Regional failover: we will enable US<->EU failover and include runbook-run validation during onboarding (David will coordinate the failover test).
- Support: Premium 24/7 oncall, P0 response target 15 minutes
- Burst credits: 10 burst credits included for immediate peak coverage
- Compliance: SOC2 report available here: https://s3.redwood.com/compliance/soc2_report_2026.pdf

Attachments: amendment-draft.pdf (contains the phased ramp language and discount mechanics). Please review and let us know any edits; we're prepared to route the amendment via DocuSign here: https://redwood-inference.docusign.com/Bluehaven-Amendment

Requested next steps:
1) Sign amendment by 11/19 to lock the pricing and onboarding dates.
2) DocuSign execution will trigger scheduling of the onboarding runbook and capacity reservation.
3) David will reach out to coordinate the failover test window and a short SLI baseline collection.

If you'd prefer a straight 24-month firm commitment today, we can remove the pilot ramp and meet the 200/100 SLOs on day one — we'd just need to align on the onboarding window to ensure KV warmup and capacity placement.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Bluehaven on the upgraded plan.

Best,
